items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: He gave me a job playing piano in a group that consisted of Ron Washington on tenor saxophone.

ctx.x: Shelly was my -- probably my first -- well, I mentioned the Mel Torme drumming thing, and when I was in, I think, my first year of high school or even still in junior high school, I heard Shelly play. And that's what got me into this business too.
Yeah, Shelly's been in Denver. He knew all the musicians. And we had the Sunday jam sessions there. He gave me a job playing piano in a group that consisted of Ron Washington on tenor saxophone.
I've worked with Ron. Yeah, I've played jobs with him.
